Payment of Student Fees: At the time of admission students have to pay the admission processing fee, security and first semester fee in advance. For BBA and BS Accounting & Finance, HBS Licencing Fee @ Rs.15,000/year would be included in the invoice at the time of admission. Invoice/Challan for admission charges along with first semester fee and Provisional Selection Letter will be available on NUST website. Tuition fee will be payable on semester basis. Students must have to pay their fee in advance before the commencement of the semester. Summer semester/course repeat/improvement fee is Rs. 11,000/per credit hour. All students are responsible to keep in record the copies of paid invoices throughout their academic tenure. “ SWIFT Message ” from sender Bank is essentially required in case money is transferred from abroad Note : All fees and other charges are subject to revision from time to time. Fee Structure for International Students (In USD): ​ ​All UG Programmes ​Admission Processing Fee (Non-Refundable) ​USD 600 ​Tuition Fee (per annum) ​USD 5,400 ​Security Deposit (Refundable) ​USD 250 ​Health facilities (per annum) ​USD 120   Tuition fee for the first academic year (two semesters) will be deposited as per selection letter. Subsequent, tuition fee will be paid through challan form generated by Finance Directorate, NUST. The security deposit is payable along with the admission processing fee at the time of admission. Course repeat/Improvement/summer semester Fee is USD 40 per credit hour. “ SWIFT Message ” from sender Bank is essentially required in case money is transferred from abroad. “Harvard Business school licensing fee” will be charged to undergraduate students of BBA, BS Accounting & Finance and BS Tourism & Hospitality Management @ USD 50 Per year. Note : All fees and other charges are subject to revision from time to time.
